text:
sara: Hey team — emergency daycare just fell through for tomorrow morning (8–1). Can Redwood advance up to $300 for a short-term sitter/daycare while I sort longer-term care? Also need someone to cover Wed 9–12 if possible. cc @people-ops
jordan (People Ops): We do have an Emergency Childcare Advance process. Typical max is $250, but manager approval can authorize more in special cases. Need a quick form + receipt upload within 14 days. For shift swaps, coordinate with your manager and post the swap in the team rota.
sara: Thanks — my manager is @ashley. Ashley, would you be able to approve $300 and cover the Wed slot? I can submit receipts within the window.
ashley: I can approve the $300 one-off and take the Wed 9–12 slot. @people-ops can you confirm the payroll flow so sara knows what to submit?
michelle (People Ops): Hi all — thanks. We can make a one-time Emergency Advance up to $300 with manager sign-off. Process: 1) Fill the short advance form (link: https://intranet.redwood/hr/advances). 2) Reply to payroll@redwood.com with subject EMER-ADV <your-name> and attach manager approval screenshot. 3) Upload any receipts to the form within 14 days. If receipts match the advance, we finalize it as non-deducted. If no receipts are submitted within 30 days, payroll will deduct the advance from next paycheck.
payroll-bot: To initiate: email payroll@redwood.com + attach manager approval. Mark subject EMER-ADV. Processing ETA: next payroll run (if submitted >72 hours before cut-off) otherwise next cycle.
sara: Filing the form now and emailing payroll. Thank you both — will upload receipt after the sitter confirms. :pray:
ben-oncall: If you need another swap for Tues morning I can switch — just @mention me in the rota post.
sara: Added you in the rota, ben-oncall. Really appreciate everyone jumping in.
